question: In the April 2025 Internaonal Shoong Sport Federaon World Cup, in which shoong event did Saurabh Chaudhary win a bronze medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10 m Air Pistol**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saurabh Chaudhary** won the **bronze medal** in the **10 m Air Pistol** event at the **April 2025 International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) World Cup**.
 
• The **10 m Air Pistol** is a highly competitive shooting event where athletes aim at stationary targets from a distance of **10 meters** using an air pistol.
 
• Saurabh Chaudhary is an accomplished Indian shooter and has previously earned international recognition in this event, including winning multiple medals in major competitions.
 
• The ISSF World Cup is an important tournament in the field of shooting sports, bringing together top shooters from around the world to compete in various shooting disciplines.
 
• This achievement further solidifies **Saurabh Chaudhary's position** as one of India's leading shooters and a prominent figure in the sport globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **10 m Air Pistol Event:**

 
 
• The 10 m Air Pistol is a precision shooting discipline where shooters aim at a target with a diameter of **11.5 mm** positioned at a distance of **10 meters**.
 
• Participants use specially designed air pistols with **pellets** as ammunition.
 
• The event demands exceptional **concentration, control, and accuracy**, making it one of the most technical shooting sports.
 
 
 
• **Saurabh Chaudhary's Achievements:**
 
 
• Saurabh Chaudhary is a **gold medalist** at the **2018 Asian Games** in the 10 m Air Pistol event.
 
• He has consistently represented India in international competitions, earning accolades in prestigious tournaments like the ISSF World Cups and World Championships.
 
• His success has contributed significantly to the growth of shooting sports in India.
 
 
 
• **ISSF World Cup:**
 
 
• The International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) organizes the World Cup series annually, featuring events in disciplines like rifle, pistol, and shotgun shooting.
 
• The tournament serves as a platform for shooters to qualify for the **Olympics** and other major international competitions.
 
• India has emerged as a strong contender in the ISSF World Cup, with shooters like Saurabh Chaudhary bringing laurels to the country.
 
 
 
• **Other Shooting Events:**
 
 
• **50 m Rifle 3 Positions:** Involves shooting in kneeling, prone, and standing positions, requiring versatility and precision.
 
• **25 m Rapid Fire Pistol:** A dynamic event where shooters fire at five targets within a limited time frame.
 
• **Skeet Shooting:** A shotgun event where participants aim at clay targets launched into the air.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Shooting Sport in India:**

 
 
• Shooting has gained immense popularity in India, with athletes like **Abhinav Bindra**, **Manu Bhaker**, and **Rahi Sarnobat** achieving international success.
 
• The **National Rifle Association of India (NRAI)** plays a pivotal role in promoting and governing shooting sports in the country.
 
• Government initiatives and schemes, such as the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)**, provide financial support and training facilities to Indian shooters.
 
 
 
• **ISSF Ranking System:**
 
 
• The ISSF maintains a ranking system to evaluate shooters based on their performance in international competitions.
 
• Saurabh Chaudhary has consistently ranked among the top shooters in the world in the 10 m Air Pistol category.
